translations./garage/brief: A storm has severed the relay road. Assemble RO-1, then choose a bounded construction plan. Only a deck that satisfies geometry and support contracts can enter the world.
translations./prediction/hint: The plan must meet both anchors exactly. Unsupported, overlong, or mismatched parts never enter physics.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: Commit the 3.0 m short steel deck
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Its length matches both bank anchors. One commit publishes the map revision, deck collision, LiDAR returns, and visible structure at the same simulation boundary.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Commit the 3.0 m high-grip grating deck
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: It also satisfies the anchor geometry. Coarse drained grating trades slightly higher drag for more wet traction reserve, enabling a same-seed comparison with smooth plate.
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: Try the 4.5 m long steel deck
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: The component is longer than the 3.0 m gap and cannot seat on both fixed anchors. Validation rejects it and leaves the world unchanged.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: new map revision received; planning across the committed deck.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1: bridge returns and mapped support agree; monitoring contact and clearance.
translations./debrief/success_summary: RO-1 planned from the constructed 2.5D map and crossed the same scannable deck through real wheel contact.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Inspect the plan contract, map revision, deck contact, and local trajectory to find where world consistency was lost.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Plan hash, map revision, LiDAR intensity, wheel contact, and final trajectory come from one deterministic run.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/collision-static: Response failed: RO-1 contacted solid geometry outside the route
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Response failed: the relay was not reached in time
translations./debrief/failure_titles/no-feasible-rout: Response failed: no continuous route exists in the constructed map
translations./debrief/failure_titles/rollover: Response failed: the vehicle lost stable support
